scope: Full static review of relocation actions, recovery, status panel, plan and relocated-object parsers; bounded read/write transports reused
findings: Unbounded action transport now uses verified maintenanceRequest.
notes: Forward/reverse scope is bound to saved plan identity; roots and complete file totals validated before review.
PREPARE and SWITCH require separate typed confirmation and renewed review.
Switch callback disables stale shared editing before dispatch; success or uncertainty requires reload.
Timeout does not authorize retry or cancel server execution.
Recovery binds original source workspace and direction; callback disables stale editing before dispatch and unresolved state requires reload.
Read-only stage, writable binding and activation remain separate from explicit copied-object integrity; empty scope cannot produce PASS.
